operations_summary: Drilled from 1845 m to 2180 m MD. Reached 9-5/8" casing setting depth at top of Rogaland Group. Pumped 15 m3 high-vis sweep, circulated hole clean with 2 bottoms up. Flow checked stable. Tripped out of hole to run casing.
remarks: Tight spot noted at 1920 m on trip out; reamed through with 50 kN overpull.
